Most days you are running work orders across several villages, so the properties change and so does the work. One stop is a no heat call, the next is a leaking supply line, the next is a door that will not latch and a GFI that keeps tripping. You diagnose it, you fix it, and you close it out before you drive to the next one. The part that matters most is what happens when a job goes sideways. Nobody expects every work order to be easy and clean. What we expect is a call to dispatch before you leave the site, every time, so the resident and the Property Manager hear it from us instead of finding out three days later. What You'll Need 5+ years in residential maintenance, with formal training through an apprenticeship or vocational program Real working knowledge of plumbing, electrical, HVAC, carpentry, drywall, and general repair, not just one lane The ability to diagnose the actual cause and complete the repair correctly on the first visit Enough familiarity with residential code to walk a property with a municipal inspector and know what you are looking at Expert command of hand, power, and specialty tools, and you already own your own basic set Valid Illinois driver's license, clean driving record, your own insured working vehicle, and an active I PASS Comfort working off a smartphone and tablet, since work orders, photos, and time cards are all digital and there is no paper The physical ability to lift 30+ pounds, climb stairs and ladders, work in crawl spaces, and stay on your feet all day in Chicago weather High school diploma or equivalent, and the ability to pass a pre employment background screening What Helps 8+ years in the trade Scattered site rental property repair experience, which is a different job than running one complex EPA, OSHA 10 or 30, general contractor, or handyman license, and we will help you get what you are missing Experience taking point on a job and showing a newer tech how it gets done Why People Stay Techs do not leave here because the work dried up or the company got sold. We have been at this since 2003, we are still adding doors, and the people who do good work keep getting more of it. If you want a route you can count on, a paycheck every Friday, and a company that is going to be here, this is the place. The GC Realty Experience™ - Responsive, Own It, Get Stuff Done (GSD), Better Results Together, these make up The GC Realty Experience™. It is not a slogan. It shows up in how we communicate, how we solve problems, and how we treat every person who comes in contact with our brand, whether that is a resident, a client, a vendor, or a new team member. We make doing business with us easy. We offer the right solutions the first time and leave everyone with an experience worth talking about. That standard does not change when things get hard. In fact, that is exactly when it matters most. No matter where you sit in the company, you are responsible for making The GC Realty Experience™ real every single day. Are you the right fit???
